units.source_excerpt: In order to better maximize investment returns, traders are always looking to study historical price movements in order to develop effective trading strategies.
units.function: Open on the reader's motive, then fold four jobs into one sentence so the whole paper is promised before any method appears.
units.reusable_pattern: State what the reader wants, then list the jobs the paper will do, and stop before the method.
reusable_elements: a purpose clause aimed at the reader
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reuse the trader, the returns, or the four jobs.

features.clause_structure: purpose clause, then one main clause with a list

In order to better keep a frame square, woodworkers are always looking to study old joints in order to develop reliable shop habits.

units.source_excerpt: In this paper, we introduce classical factors of stock investment based on the historical prices of bitcoin and gold, and use a mathematical optimization model to calculate the optimal parameters of the factors, and subsequently form a portfolio investment strategy by composing the factors into a voting system on this basis.
units.function: Chain the whole method as one sentence whose clauses run in the order the models will run.
units.reusable_pattern: Give the method as a single sentence of chained clauses, each clause one stage, in the order the stages run.
reusable_elements: a closer that names the last stage
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reuse the factors, the voting system, or the asset names.

In this note, we bring in the old habits of a workshop based on the boards we have kept, and use a small trial to settle the best sizes for each one, and subsequently build a weekly job from them on this basis.

units.source_excerpt: An improved investment strategy based on forecasting and risk control is then proposed.
